title: The Plain dress of the woman
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：plain　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 plain 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the builder wrote of ① a plain dress of the woman in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② plainer than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the plain ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the plainest dress of the woman anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1968 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too plain to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the plain ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a plain fact of the matter, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as plain as the fact of the matter they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was plain or not, and he said so.

By 1981 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something plain, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite plain; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the plain ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1984, for the whole place, she wrote of another plain dress of the woman in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ plainer than anybody had expected. ⑩ The plainest fact of the matter in the whole site, she said in 1986, was the one she could never quite name; the plain ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 朴素（前置定语 a plain dress of the woman：1974 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件朴素的衣裙）
B. adj. 朴素／明显（比较级 plainer than：文中两处，一处比女人朴素的衣裙，一处比预想）
C. adj. 朴素／明显（最高级 the plainest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 朴素（表语 too plain to do：母亲觉得它太朴素，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 明显（前置定语 a plain fact of the matter：叔叔把整件事称作一桩明显的事实）
F. adj. 明显（同级比较 as plain as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩明摆着的事实相比）
G. adj. 明显（后置定语 something plain：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 明显（受程度副词修饰 quite plain：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: a plain dress of the woman
the plainest dress of the woman anybody
a plain fact of the matter
The plainest fact of the matter in

answers.why: plain 意为“朴素”，1974 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件朴素的衣裙”，此处作前置定语 a plain dress of the woman。
plain 意为“朴素”，此处用比较级 plainer than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
plain 意为“朴素”，施工图上 十月 那行字说它是工地里最朴素的一件，故用最高级 the plainest dress of the woman。
plain 意为“朴素”，母亲认为这件东西“太朴素了，谁也用不上”，too plain to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
plain 意为“明显”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩明显的事实”，此处作前置定语 a plain fact of the matter。
plain 意为“明显”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩明摆着的事实一样明显”，同级比较用 as plain as。
plain 意为“明显”，施工图上那半行字要的是“明显的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something plain。
plain 意为“明显”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当明显”，quite 修饰原级 plain。
plain 意为“明显”，1984 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要明显”，故用比较级 plainer than。
plain 意为“明显”，母亲 1986 年说的是“整个工地里最明显的那一桩”，故用最高级 the plainest fact of the matter。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件朴素的衣裙。（a plain dress of the woman）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更朴素。（plainer than …）
母亲觉得它太朴素，谁也用不上。（too plain to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩明显的事实。（a plain fact of the matter）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩明摆着的事实一样明显。（as plain as …）
到了 1981 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件明显的东西。（something plain）
answers: In 1974 the builder wrote of a plain dress of the woman in the plan.
Everybody said it was plainer than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too plain to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a plain fact of the matter.
He said nobody would call it as plain as the fact of the matter they had once had.
By 1981 the plan asked for nothing but something plain.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 plain 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1974 the builder wrote of a plain dress of the woman in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the plainest dress of the woman in the site, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too plain to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a plain fact of the matter, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite plain, and everybody laughed.
The plain ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
